verses.text: After this Job opened his mouth, and cursed the day of his birth.
Job answered:
“Let the day perish in which I was born, the night which said, ‘There is a boy conceived.’
lines: “Let the day perish in which I was born,
the night which said, ‘There is a boy conceived.’

verses.text: Let that day be darkness. Don’t let God from above seek for it, neither let the light shine on it.
lines: Let that day be darkness.
Don’t let God from above seek for it,
neither let the light shine on it.

verses.text: Let darkness and the shadow of death claim it for their own. Let a cloud dwell on it. Let all that makes black the day terrify it.
lines: Let darkness and the shadow of death claim it for their own.
Let a cloud dwell on it.
Let all that makes black the day terrify it.

verses.text: As for that night, let thick darkness seize on it. Let it not rejoice among the days of the year. Let it not come into the number of the months.
lines: As for that night, let thick darkness seize on it.
Let it not rejoice among the days of the year.
Let it not come into the number of the months.

verses.text: Behold, let that night be barren. Let no joyful voice come therein.
lines: Behold, let that night be barren.
Let no joyful voice come therein.

verses.text: Let them curse it who curse the day, who are ready to rouse up leviathan.
lines: Let them curse it who curse the day,
who are ready to rouse up leviathan.

verses.text: Let the stars of its twilight be dark. Let it look for light, but have none, neither let it see the eyelids of the morning,
lines: Let the stars of its twilight be dark.
Let it look for light, but have none,
neither let it see the eyelids of the morning,

verses.text: because it didn’t shut up the doors of my mother’s womb, nor did it hide trouble from my eyes.
lines: because it didn’t shut up the doors of my mother’s womb,
nor did it hide trouble from my eyes.

verses.text: “Why didn’t I die from the womb? Why didn’t I give up the spirit when my mother bore me?
lines: “Why didn’t I die from the womb?
Why didn’t I give up the spirit when my mother bore me?

verses.text: Why did the knees receive me? Or why the breast, that I should nurse?
lines: Why did the knees receive me?
Or why the breast, that I should nurse?

verses.text: For now should I have lain down and been quiet. I should have slept, then I would have been at rest,
lines: For now should I have lain down and been quiet.
I should have slept, then I would have been at rest,

verses.text: with kings and counselors of the earth, who built up waste places for themselves;
lines: with kings and counselors of the earth,
who built up waste places for themselves;

verses.text: or with princes who had gold, who filled their houses with silver:
lines: or with princes who had gold,
who filled their houses with silver:

verses.text: or as a hidden untimely birth I had not been, as infants who never saw light.
lines: or as a hidden untimely birth I had not been,
as infants who never saw light.

verses.text: There the wicked cease from troubling. There the weary are at rest.
lines: There the wicked cease from troubling.
There the weary are at rest.

verses.text: There the prisoners are at ease together. They don’t hear the voice of the taskmaster.
lines: There the prisoners are at ease together.
They don’t hear the voice of the taskmaster.

verses.text: The small and the great are there. The servant is free from his master.
lines: The small and the great are there.
The servant is free from his master.

verses.text: “Why is light given to him who is in misery, life to the bitter in soul,
lines: “Why is light given to him who is in misery,
life to the bitter in soul,

verses.text: Who long for death, but it doesn’t come; and dig for it more than for hidden treasures,
lines: Who long for death, but it doesn’t come;
and dig for it more than for hidden treasures,

verses.text: who rejoice exceedingly, and are glad, when they can find the grave?
lines: who rejoice exceedingly,
and are glad, when they can find the grave?

verses.text: Why is light given to a man whose way is hidden, whom God has hedged in?
lines: Why is light given to a man whose way is hidden,
whom God has hedged in?

verses.text: For my sighing comes before I eat. My groanings are poured out like water.
lines: For my sighing comes before I eat.
My groanings are poured out like water.

verses.text: For the thing which I fear comes on me, That which I am afraid of comes to me.
lines: For the thing which I fear comes on me,
That which I am afraid of comes to me.

verses.text: I am not at ease, neither am I quiet, neither have I rest; but trouble comes.”
lines: I am not at ease, neither am I quiet, neither have I rest;
but trouble comes.”
